answer: ZK-proof of post-epoch generation: each miner submits a SNARK proving compute ran after the prior epoch's seed. The "sonnet" circuit hashes 2^20 rounds; the "marble" Merkle root binds it to the seed. Forged proofs need ~500 CPU-hours plus a trusted setup break, ~$12 per identity attempt across 10k sybils. The "signal" is only valid if seed freshness verifies on-chain, so stale pre-computation fails. Attacker cost scales linearly per fake ID while honest yield stays flat — farming goes negative fast. This works because generation timing is cryptographically bound to unpredictable epoch entropy.
